blocks.text: 🪝 REC & PFC Sign ₹26,850 Crore Loan Agreement for 2,400 MW Meja Thermal Power Project. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Finances 3 Ultra-Super Critical units of 800 MW each at Meja, Uttar Pradesh.
Financing Structure: REC and PFC equal 50:50 debt funding of ₹26,850 crore for MUNPL (50:50 JV between NTPC and UPRVUNL).
Project Completion Cost: Estimated at ₹38,357.81 crore equipped with Air Cooled Condenser (ACC) system.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
